== Summary ==
Identified: [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, white shirt, at lane 14). Other bowlers, including a grey-haired player in a black Euro Emperor stormtrooper shirt seen from behind, are not named from this frame.

Bowling on the leaving day at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 4 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 4 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-04
* '''Identification:''' [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, white shirt, at lane 14). Other bowlers, including a grey-haired player in a black Euro Emperor stormtrooper shirt seen from behind, are not named from this frame.
